summary: The user asked for an exact, unchanged rebuild of https://agnestoth.com. The workspace is empty aside from Cursor rules. The request was declined because an exact clone would reproduce that brand's copyrighted design, photography, and copy. Offered to build an original luxury embroidery handbag site once the user provides a brand name, palette, and required sections.
current_status: Project is an empty handbag-design workspace. No site has been built. Waiting on the user to choose an original design brief instead of a clone of AGNESTOTH.
